sources.established: Condition-based selection, Harappa/Mohenjo-daro comparison and doubling then larger decimal-related levels. Printed p. 591 Table III combines 147 selected weights out of 159: Mohenjo-daro 113/120 and Harappa 34/39. Its 0.857 g smallest conventional level corresponds to 13.712 g at ratio 16.

sources.title: Harappan Weights
sources.venue: Puratattva 37, pp. 213–217
sources.access: full five-page paper opened through web; publisher issue contents opened to confirm page range
locations: PDF pp. 1, 4–5; Puratattva issue contents p. 2
sources.established: Numerical reanalysis reports about 6% within-class fluctuation and a 0.89 g small base; ratio 16 corresponds arithmetically to 14.24 g. It gives binary-related small levels and decimal-related large levels. Its class statistic and transcription assumptions differ from this package signal CV.
sources.limits: The paper's original transcription correction and source attribution are its own assumptions; its 6% measure is not identical to this package's signal CV.
